description: This file defines a feature for deleting a favorite article in a web application, including command validation and a request handler that interacts with the database context to remove a favorite association.

classes.name: Delete.Command
classes.description: Represents the command to delete a favorite article identified by its slug.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates the command ensuring the slug is not null or empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the delete favorite article request by interacting with the database context.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the logic to remove a favorite article for the current user, throwing exceptions if the article or user is not found.
